commands._comment: Use to select specific spoken text (up to ten words) in the current text area. Example: 'select essential hypertension'. Pairs with the enum-based selection commands in select.json - commands with enum variables are recognized before commands with wildcard variables.
Use to select a span of spoken text between the trigger and a literal endpoint, as an alternative to the ten word cap of select_text. Example: 'select forty year old male end select'
Use to place the cursor before or after specific spoken text in the current text area. Example: 'insert before hypertension'. Pairs with the enum-based insert_cursor command in navigation.json.
